notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Cleric.
description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Zombie" on Rotlung Reanimator to "Cleric" until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other Cleric, adding {C}{C}.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Cleric creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
